verified_scope: R1 fix (src/app.js:90-98): markSiblings(e,q) (line 92) runs the sibling loop only for C11 basic questions. It does not mark q itself. exposeQuestion (line 93) = markHelp(e,q) + markSiblings. The hint button (97) and solution button (98) both still call exposeQuestion.

The check handler (line 96) calls submitAnswer first, then attemptFor. It calls markSiblings when r?.correct || attempt.history.length>=2 || this.revealed.has(q.id), and it does this before feedbackHTML renders. This condition matches exactly the cases where feedbackHTML (line 90) adds q.reason: a correct answer always shows the reason, and a wrong answer shows it once history>=2 or the solution was revealed. On the first wrong attempt with no reveal, only the targeted feedback or hint is shown and nothing is marked. So every path where the check button shows the shared solution now also marks the sibling basic question.

First record stays immutable (state.js:12-21). markHelp only sets attemptFor(...).helpUsed=true. submitAnswer reads helpUsed only when it creates a.first. A first attempt already stored is never changed, so marking a sibling afterwards cannot rewrite its first record. Malformed input is rejected by validAnswer in app.js before submitAnswer and markSiblings run, so it marks nothing.

The R1 scenario now gives the right result. When basic-1 gets -25 twice, history reaches 2, so markSiblings sets helpUsed on basic-2 before basic-2 is first submitted. basic-2's first.helped is then true. The basic part of initialEvidence (state.js:24) has no unhelped first-correct answer left, so finishLesson leaves initialAt=0 and needsWork=!initialAt=true. Control case: if basic-1 is correct on the first try, it was submitted before any marking, so it stays first.correct with helped=false. Marking basic-2 afterwards does not change the outcome, so initialEvidence is still true.
The order doesn't matter. If basic-2 is answered correctly first, basic-1 is marked as helped. basic-2 itself then satisfies the basic requirement, the same as in the control case.

tests/browser.py:116-136 does what the R1 verification asked for: fresh contexts, '-25' submitted twice, all checks then answered correctly, finishLesson, and assertions on initialAt and needsWork for both cases. It checks the final outcome rather than asserting basic-2's first.helped directly, but in this setup the outcome depends on that flag. tests/verify.mjs:57 covers the same rule at state level.

known-errors.js: known() creates a new {value,feedback,tag} object for each id inside the loop. So the later KNOWN_ERRORS['P13-check-1'].tag override does not leak to P17-check-3, which shares the same entry text. lesson-schema.js:9 adds the known error only to non-choice questions with no wrong list (the N/R/I/S default is []). It keeps the {value,feedback,tag} shape that feedbackHTML (match.feedback) and submitAnswer (.tag) expect. The tags are already in prefixed form ('A5-M3'). concept() runs earlier, at course-module time, so the tags are not prefixed twice.

author.js: concept() prefixes M-tags with the lesson id for both explicit tags and wrong-answer tags. When the lesson id is in ERROR_TARGET, it sets tags on choice error and error-location questions. pickQ adds a null tag for the correct option at index 0. finalizeLesson's shuffle reorders tags together with the options and feedback.

Bundler (scripts/build.mjs:14) concatenates math → known-errors → lesson-schema → author → course IIFEs → content → state/retrieval/visuals/app. Each module comes before anything that uses it. Every import in src and src/courses is on a single line, so the strip regex removes all of them, and the export prefixes are only const/function. No top-level names collide across the files at bundle scope: known/KNOWN_ERRORS, numberQ/pickQ/errorSet/ERROR_TARGET/concept, and the names in state, visuals and app are all distinct. Course-level names are isolated inside their IIFEs. The sourceNames variable is declared but not used, which is harmless.
dist/index.html contains the new code: the three markSiblings(e,q) call sites and the KNOWN_ERRORS merge in finalizeLesson are present. A grep found no leftover import/export lines.
